sentences.en: For example, the demonstration plant will re-use the extra gas emerging from the process to heat the lime kiln in the pulp production process instead of using exhaustible raw materials such as oil.

sentences.en: We can divide the nature resources into two parts , one is exhaustible resources renewable resources.
